name: Asuga Saintil
source:
A spunky ringleader who views their Ultimate talent as belonging to their entire circus as acting as a representative for them. She's circus as opposed to just them, heavily liked by her own circus, most of them viewing her as their "Big Sib" Her peppy but sympathetic approach to life makes her fairly easy to depend on.

While initially Asuga seems outgoing, loud and in the same camp as some of the more annoying prisoners they're genuinely more well liked and respected than other Similarly aged prisoners due to their general underlying maturity and practical Can-do attitude. Asuga seems to constantly have the other younger prisoners in mind when considering their actions.

After their interrogation I can firmly say she's the prisoner I'm rooting for the most. They seem to understand their own wrongdoing but also the necessity of their actions.

[From the [url=https://danganronpa-fanganprojects.fandom.com/wiki/Asuga_Saintil]Wiki[/url]]
